verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents admin-enforced org-wide policies such as requiring app lock, restricting export, or mandating master password strength. The closest items are adjacent: service-account vault and action scoping, device-trust messaging, and a user-facing export feature. None of these is an admin policy control over members' apps.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
